method: Definitions RELIGHT sim6 t_relight = the relight command E0 (phase 4 entry, the lift; the forced purge of amendment P ends here; the light follows after the start delay). 'At RELIGHT' = the 1 ms record stamped t_relight (end of the last step before the relight decision). Windows: the W s before it, records stamped in (t_relight - W, t_relight]; 'purge' = from the purge start (prg_t0) to t_relight (P25 arms); 'E0-light' = from t_relight to the first record of phase 5. f specific force (non-gravitational force / mass, what an ideal accelerometer reads) in body axes. At the CG: f = R(q)^T (dv/dt + g z_world) from the 1 ms record, q of the previous record (the attitude the step used); the reconstructed f_z is checked against the recorded sim6 fb[2] ('fax'). At a body station z_s on the axis: f_s = f_CG + alpha x r + w x (w x r), r = (0, 0, z_s - z_cg), alpha from the recorded body rates (the method of m2_coast_accel_a1 v1; CG lateral offset, 2 mm sd, neglected). theta angle between body +z and f_s: atan2(|f_lat|, f_z), deg (0 = f along the body axis). az azimuth of the lateral part of f_s in body axes, atan2(f_y, f_x) mod 360, deg, from +x toward +y. The gimbal is at neutral in these windows (below), so body axes = engine axes. Mechanical's coil_tilt_screen_v341 'up' vector u = (sin th cos az, sin th sin az, cos th) is f / |f| here if the CAD X, Y, Z axes are the sim body axes (the sim's servo-lever azimuths 135 / 225 deg are read from mechanical.json in that convention; frame identity TO-CONFIRM). stations 'hose': the coil at z_pivot + 0.073 m (ASSUMED: coil z 72-74 mm in coil_tilt_screen_v341_v1 with the CAD origin taken at the gimbal pivot, TO-CONFIRM); 'seat': z_pivot + 0.1106 m (mechanical.json v2 z_seat, as m2_coast_accel_a1); 'pivot'; 'mv': z 0.5 m (ASSUMED, as m2_coast_accel_a1); 'cg'. The lateral specific force depends on the station (a nose-drogue force change rotates the body about a centre of percussion about I_t / (m l_tip) = 0.22 m below the CG, near the engine: stations near it see the smallest theta), so the station values are reported side by side. 'imu_meas': the IMU station z_imu with the run's accelerometer bias and scale factor (white noise omitted: 1 mm/s/sqrt(s) is 0.0014 m/s2, 0.01 deg, on a 0.5 s average; sim6 has no IMU mounting misalignment: the installed misalignment adds to theta and is TO-DEFINE). gimbal truth engine angles (dgx, dgy) and command (dcx, dcy), |delta| = hypot of the two axes, deg.
configuration: Configuration: the A1 base of m2_purge_bleed (A1_none, liquid plan 0.81 s, relight NOT CLOSED (RG-01), flown mass estimator tot_cal_comp; seed 101, N runs; wind U(0, 8) m/s at the reference height, Dryden-like gusts x U(0.5, 1.5)), sim6 v2.8-dev MWFPR, 1 ms recorder. Arms: ref (no purge); P25 (forced purge 2.5 s + 0.5 s anticipation, 20.0 g/s, jet 2.1 N whose reaction acts toward body azimuth bl_az = 0 deg at the pivot height: vent location and direction ASSUMED, TO-DEFINE); P25_nojet (balanced or axial vent).
model_limits: Model limits: nose drogue = quasi-steady massless canopy, tension along -v_rel at the nose tip (no canopy pendulum oscillation, riser elasticity, swivel friction or inflation: a real canopy's oscillation can dominate theta; drop-test or literature data for the chosen canopy are needed before this distribution is used as a design value); first-order gust model; rigid-body specific force (no line fluid dynamics); the hump volumes of the coordinator relay (Mechanical screen, worst direction) are applied only as a conditional screen.
